set.body: Add lisa_bilateral(), is_lisa_filter(), and lisa_apply_filter() with backend dispatch. First production backend should adapt neuroim2::bilateral_filter(); neurothresh owns LISA defaults, range scaling, null-map application, boundary labels, and diagnostics, not a new general bilateral smoother. Keep a tiny reference implementation only for audited fixtures and mask/boundary tests.
set.title: LISA: bilateral filter spec and neuroim2 adapter
